LESSON: MY CREATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: My Creation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My Creation, part of Strand 1 in Grade 3 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What is a family the family tree?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. recognise the head of the family and respect them family the family?

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of My Creation in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 2. Who are your 3 lessons family for identification  Learner to draw and colour the family members?

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of My Creation in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. draw the family tree to understand relationships within family tree 3. What is a family the family tree?

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of My Creation in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. recognise the head of the family and respect them family the family?

   My Creation helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. name family members in the nuclear and extended  Learners to name family members 2. Who are your 3 lessons family for identification  Learner to draw and colour the family members?

   My Creation helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. draw the family tree to understand relationships within family tree 3. What is a family the family tree?

   My Creation helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on My Creation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Learning to learn as they name family members, imagination and creativity as they draw and colour the family tree
